newsitem.title: USA: Tobacco industry in talks with plaintiffs lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Tobacco industry in talks with plaintiffs lawyers.

text.p: Tobacco executives are negotiating with state attorneys general and plaintiffs' lawyers on a possible settlement of massive litigation against the industry, a source close to the talks told Reuters Wednesday.
The source said that the talks, which began about two weeks ago, are continuing in Virginia and that the lawyers hope the first round will conclude later Wednesday.
